name: Instantly Positive Reply → Phone Lookup → Email Alert

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const b = $('Webhook').item.json.body ?? $('Webhook').item.json; const et = String(b.event_type ?? '').toLowerCase(); return /(interested|meeting[_ ]?booked|positive)/.test(et) && !/not[_ ]?interested/.test(et); })() }}

parameters.customBody: ={{ (() => { const k = $('Parse Signature').item.json; const b = { searchMode: 'name', firstName: k.firstName, lastName: k.lastName, state: k.state, maxItems: $('Config').item.json.MAX_RECORDS }; if (k.city) b.city = k.city; return JSON.stringify(b); })() }}
